questions.q: A 1024×1024 image, 8× VAE, patch 2. How many tokens?
In SD 3's modulate, how is the scale from the time vector applied?
options: One value per channel, the same across all tokens
questions.answer: One value per channel, the same across all tokens
questions.why: modulate broadcasts along the token axis, as the lab checks. Per-token work is left to attention.

questions.q: What does a gate of zero do in a DiT block?
questions.why: x + 0 × attention is x. adaLN-Zero uses this at the start of training.

questions.q: What's the key difference between joint attention and plain cross-attention?
options: In joint attention the text tokens also receive information from the image
Joint attention needs no text encoder
questions.answer: In joint attention the text tokens also receive information from the image
questions.why: Text and image sit in one sequence, so both move. The lab's nudge test shows that.

questions.q: You lower a patch from 2 to 1 at the same image size. What happens to pairs?
questions.why: Tokens multiply by 4, and pairs by 16, the same as doubling the image side.
